statement: Elevation was a significant predictor of mean detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 9.525, p = 9.2e-08).
Elevation was a significant predictor of total richness (ANOVA, F = 9.095, p = 1.1e-07).
Elevation was a significant predictor of Shannon diversity (ANOVA, F = 3.323, p = 0.002).
Elevation was a significant predictor of Lepidoptera detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 5.374, p = 3.8e-05).
Elevation was a significant predictor of Coleoptera detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 6.269, p = 8.5e-06).
Elevation was a significant predictor of Hemiptera detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 4.465, p = 0.00024).
Elevation was a significant predictor of Diptera detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 4.354, p = 0.00039).
Session was not a significant predictor of Lepidoptera detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 0.825, p = 0.51).
Session was a significant predictor of Coleoptera detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 23.647, p = 2.6e-16).
Session was a significant predictor of Hemiptera detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 23.699, p = 2.4e-16).
Session was a significant predictor of Diptera detections per photo (ANOVA, F = 3.732, p = 0.0058).
Lepidoptera: session not significant (p = 0.43), elevation band significant (p = 2.1e-07), interaction not significant (p = 0.56).
Coleoptera: session significant (p = <2e-16), elevation band significant (p = 0.00034), interaction significant (p = 1.2e-07).
Hemiptera: session significant (p = <2e-16), elevation band significant (p = 4.5e-10), interaction significant (p = 0.0091).
Diptera: session significant (p = 0.0024), elevation band significant (p = 1.5e-07), interaction not significant (p = 0.76).
